rider_report.post_session_context: Rider felt three laps was too little and wanted a stronger fourth effort to test whether the coach was being too conservative. This was also the first day riding clipless after about eight years on flat pedals.

lap_map.lap_1: Access/initial loop to get from car park to 2K and through the end of 2K.
lap_map.loop_1_prescribed: Laps 2 and 3: tarmac climb back to 2K start, then 2K descent to finish.
lap_map.loop_2_prescribed: Laps 4 and 5: tarmac climb back to 2K start, then 2K descent to finish.
lap_map.loop_3_prescribed: Laps 6 and 7: tarmac climb back to 2K start, then 2K descent to finish.
lap_map.loop_4_prescribed: Laps 9 and 10: tarmac climb back to 2K start, then 2K descent to finish.
lap_map.lap_12_to_13: Exit loop from 2K area; includes another tarmac climb and ride back toward the car park/end of 2K.

coach_notes.route_interpretation: Use climb-plus-descent pairs, not climb-only laps, as the primary 2K workout unit. Laps 2-3, 4-5, 6-7, and 9-10 are the four prescribed loops. Lap 1 and laps 12-13 are access/exit riding, with lap 12 adding another real climb.
coach_notes.prescription_quality_review: The session was better framed as four 2K climb-plus-descent loops, with access and exit load acknowledged. Future prescriptions for this route should state loop count, climb power cap, descent quality target, and whether access/exit climbs count against the workload.
